save_visit.description: Save notes and append a report with the new photos for this fictional visit

steps.sql: UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs SET notes=$1::jsonb->>'notes',version=version+1 WHERE id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND version=($1::jsonb->>'version')::integer AND length(trim($1::jsonb->>'notes')) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 RETURNING id,version,notes

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_field_reports(id,job_id,request_id,fingerprint,notes,temperature,pressure,correction_of,source,attachments)
       SELECT 'FR-'||$2::text,j.id,$2::text,md5($1::jsonb::text),$1::jsonb->>'notes',coalesce($1::jsonb->>'temperature',''),coalesce($1::jsonb->>'pressure',''),nullif($1::jsonb->>'correction_of',''),'Company app',coalesce($1::jsonb->'attachments','[]'::jsonb)
       FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs j WHERE j.id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND length(trim($1::jsonb->>'notes')) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000
       AND jsonb_typeof(coalesce($1::jsonb->'attachments','[]'::jsonb))='array'
       AND jsonb_array_length(coalesce($1::jsonb->'attachments','[]'::jsonb))<=5
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce($1::jsonb->'attachments','[]'::jsonb)) v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v)!='string' OR trim(both '"' from v::text)!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
       AND (nullif($1::jsonb->>'temperature','') IS NULL OR ($1::jsonb->>'temperature')::numeric BETWEEN -50 AND 150)
       AND (nullif($1::jsonb->>'pressure','') IS NULL OR ($1::jsonb->>'pressure')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)
       AND (nullif($1::jsonb->>'correction_of','') IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_field_reports f WHERE f.id=$1::jsonb->>'correction_of' AND f.job_id=j.id)) RETURNING id
